title: Reptile Terrarium Climate and UVB
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vivarium:climate
| stats latest(basking_c) as basking, latest(cool_c) as cool, latest(humidity_pct) as humidity, latest(uvi) as uvi by enclosure
| eval gradient_ok=if(basking>=32 AND cool<=26,"good","check"), uvb_ok=if(uvi>=2,"good","low")
description: Checks a reptile's enclosure keeps a proper warm-to-cool gradient, humidity, and UVB, the essentials of reptile health.
value: Reptiles depend entirely on their environment; monitoring the gradient and UVB prevents the slow health decline of poor husbandry.
implementation: Ingest terrarium climate and UV index into `index=personal`; alert when the gradient, humidity, or UVB is off.
visualization: Status panel of basking and cool temperatures, humidity, and UVB.
grandmaExplanation: It checks a reptile's tank has the right warm and cool areas, humidity, and special light it needs to stay healthy.
